_comment: MACHINE-READABLE SPINE OF THE ENGINEERING OPERATING SYSTEM.
This file exists because prose cannot be checked. Before it, SYSTEM_LAWS.md said
'55 numbered engineering laws' while the constitution had 57, and nothing in the
repository could notice. A count that drifts teaches the reader the document is
unreliable, and an unreliable document stops being consulted.
Read by .claude/hooks/engineering_method.py at runtime and by
tests/unit/test_engineering_os.py, which fails when this file and the prose
disagree. JSON, not YAML, so it parses from the standard library with no
dependency to install and no version to pin.
ADDING A GATE OR A LAW MEANS EDITING THIS FILE. The test enforces it.

core_documents.answers: how to think about any problem
the failure each rule was born from
what a load-bearing word means, measurably

gates.fires_on: designing a component, a boundary, an artifact or a contract
headline: WHY (need) -> WHAT (requirement) -> HOW (design). Never HOW -> WHY.
One owner per concept. One named artifact per arrow.
G5 boundaries: what may this component NEVER do?
G9 non-goals, written down. G10 every prior promise honoured or revised.
Inversion: how would I design this to fail forever?
Systems: what must flow across this boundary - and what must NEVER.

gates.fires_on: a vague target, or before any build starts
headline: A vague target is a REQUEST FOR A NUMBER, not a requirement (Law 52).
Ask for the number. Never infer it. Never pick one yourself.
Every SHALL: necessary, atomic, measurable, unambiguous, verifiable,
traceable, solution-independent, achievable.
Name the verification method: Inspection | Analysis | Demonstration | Test.
Undefined term? STOP and ask (Law 54). Never invent the definition.

gates.fires_on: a bug, a failure, a red check, 'why is this slow'
headline: Do not fix the first thing you find. It is a symptom.
List EVERY candidate cause. Measure each. Reject only with evidence.
A REJECTED hypothesis stays rejected unless NEW evidence appears.
WHY upward to the highest layer you can change. If the root is a CLASS, fix the class.
A document is a HYPOTHESIS, never evidence. Read the source.
Permanent regression test, watched RED first, BEFORE the fix is complete (Law 3).
Stop only when the cause is ELIMINATED - never at an explanation.

gates.fires_on: producing a number, quoting a number, claiming an improvement
headline: value . commit . source . status - or it is not a measurement.
A number without its commit is an opinion (Law 56).
Source moved after the measurement? EXPIRED. Re-measure or write UNMEASURED.
Only GitHub Actions is authoritative (Law 44). Local = LOCAL ONLY, NOT AUTHORITATIVE.
No score without a complete denominator. Name what was excluded.
UNKNOWN beats a stale number. Never invent continuity between commits.

gates.fires_on: writing a test, and before EVERY commit
headline: build -> verify -> red-team -> DONE GATE -> THEN commit (Law 51).
Watch it FAIL for the right reason first. Passed first try = wrong test.
Assert the RESULT, not that a function ran. 'Didn't throw' proves nothing.
NEVER ease a test. Only stricter (Law 4). Code fails a correct test -> fix the CODE.
A mock proves the mock. Fake only at the narrowest I/O edge.
A test can only fail on what it looks at. Check you asserted the right quantity.
Green is not done. Survived-an-attack is done.

gates.fires_on: choosing between options, trade-offs, irreversible calls
headline: Recoverable from repo/docs/practice -> DECIDE. Do not ask.
Unrecoverable AND costly-or-irreversible -> ASK once, with a recommended default.
Always ask for: an undefined term (Law 54), a measurable target (Law 52).
No recommendation without a named failure mode.
Record: context, alternatives + why each was rejected, trade-off, impact.

gates.fires_on: shipping, deploying, releasing, amending a frozen document
headline: The DONE GATE precedes the ship, never follows it (Law 51).
Off by default -> on gradually. An undo button always exists (Law 8).
Nothing posts to a real ledger on a canary.
Monitor: traffic . errors . latency . saturation - plus posted-entry correctness.
A frozen document changes ONLY by written amendment (Section M).

SessionStart.emits: the OS map and the eight most-broken laws

UserPromptSubmit.emits: the 12-stage method, plus any gate whose keywords match the prompt

PreToolUse.refuses: a banned phrase written into a truth document

PreToolUse_advisory.note: path-triggered gate headlines are printed on exit 0; whether that text reaches the model is UNMEASURED and is not claimed
